description: This file contains automated tests for the autocomplete API endpoints related to users and organizations within the application, using the Test2::V0 framework and a custom Test::Coocook module.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and expects a successful response.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login with provided credentials and expects success.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP response status matches the expected value.

methods.name: header_is
methods.description: Verifies that the response headers contain expected key-value pairs.

methods.name: json_is
methods.description: Checks if the JSON response matches the expected data structure.
